name: Etna Shaders
description: Shaders for Minecraft's native Vulkan renderer, built only on the game's own render backend. Temporal anti-aliasing, shadow map distortion and the water's Fresnel function are ported from Photon Shaders by SixthSurge (see CREDITS.md).
contributors: SixthSurge (Photon Shaders: temporal anti-aliasing, shadow distortion, water Fresnel)
